comment:
Owner's comment on the Seattle Center render: the surrounding buildings look rough. For the Armory module (plot 0) fix these, keeping the footprints, the plots and the Glasshouse and Galleries modules as they are, in 1.21.1 blocks:

1. The walls read khaki/tan. The real Armory is pale grey-white concrete (smooth quartz, white and light grey concrete, calcite) with horizontal bands of red-brown brick (bricks, red terracotta) at each floor line and along the parapet. Recolour the walls to that.
2. Along the lawn side, the ground floor should be a continuous low glass arcade (glass panes in a light frame with a flat canopy roof) projecting a few blocks in front of the wall, with entrances and a red awning or two, as in the photo of the long facade.
3. The lawn in front is planted as a grid of identical small lollipop trees. Make it an open lawn with a curving paved path along the building, lined by one row of large, tall deciduous trees (London planes: tall pale trunks, broad open crowns, 12-18 blocks tall), evenly spaced along the path; leave the middle of the lawn open grass.
4. The flat roof is bare grey with two long skylight boxes. Keep the skylights, but give the roof a parapet with the brick band, a few rooftop plant boxes and vents, and break up the bare grey with a lighter roofing block.
summary:
Armory walls are now calcite with brick bands at each floor line, the frieze and the parapet, and the coping is smooth quartz.
A glass arcade with a quartz frame and a flat canopy runs 84 blocks along the hall's lawn side (x104..107). It has 3 doors into the hall and 2 red awnings.
The grid of small trees is gone: one curving path along the building now carries a single row of 9 tall plane trees, and the middle of the lawn is open grass.
The roof keeps its skylights and now has a lighter deck with grey seams, a calcite/brick parapet, 13 plant boxes and 8 vents. Glasshouse and Galleries are untouched.
applied: 1 Recolour: the shell's walls changed from smooth_sandstone to calcite, and the chocolate brown_terracotta bands (y8, 15, 22 and the y27 frieze, the curtain-wall frieze and the slot caps) are now bricks. The roof parapet, which the roof tool carries up from the wall top, is calcite on its lower course with a brick band above and a smooth_quartz_slab coping. The porch is now calcite posts, a brick fascia and a quartz slab canopy. I kept the polished_andesite plinth and the red_terracotta door surround.

2 Lawn-side arcade: a single-storey glazed arcade along the B east wall, x104..107, z36..119. It has smooth_quartz posts every 4, glass_pane between, a quartz head beam at y5 and a flat smooth_quartz_slab canopy at y6 that overhangs one block onto the lawn. Three birch double doors face the lawn (z55, 79, 103), each matched by a new door through a pier of the hall wall. Two flat red_concrete awnings sit over the first two doors. The floor is polished andesite with hanging lanterns every 4 blocks (light minimum 8). The walk test reaches it.

3 Lawn: the 5x7 grid of small trees is removed. One polished_andesite path now runs along the building from the north edge, past the arcade, then swings east to the red canopy at the pavilion's door. Short spurs join it to the two lawn doors, and 16 lamp posts line it. Nine London planes stand evenly spaced, every 15 blocks, on the lawn side of the path. Each is 13–17 blocks tall with a pale birch_log trunk, boughs and a broad open crown 11 wide. The middle of the lawn is left as open grass.

4 Roof: both skylight monitors are kept. The bare smooth_stone deck is now a lighter polished_diorite_slab field with smooth_stone_slab seams every 8. The parapet has its brick band. There are 13 spruce planter boxes (grass soil, azaleas, a lantern in each) and 8 light-grey vent units with iron grilles and pipe vents, all clear of the monitors. This dressing is applied after the parts run, in parts/roof-dressing.mjs.

Checks: make.sh rebuilds with 0 refused writes. `mcd check` shows 0 floating and 0 orphan blocks in plot 0. In the walk test every room is reached, except the atrium volume, which was already 'partly blocked' in v1. I looked at the renders from all four sides plus a lawn view, a roof view and an arcade close-up.
skipped: Footprint conflict: the map marks the 4-wide strip x104..107 east of the hall as open ground. This was the nearest sensible fit for an arcade 'a few blocks in front of the wall', so the arcade stands on that strip, inside plot 0, and its canopy overhangs only one block onto the lawn.
London planes have mottled bark, but 1.21.1 has no plane log, so the trunks are birch_log: pale, but striped like birch.

Not changed because it wasn't in the comment, and found already present in v1: the food hall ground floor has 33 dark cells, and the 'Food hall atrium volume' room is partly blocked in the walk test. The palette tool also flags quartz trim on calcite walls as low-contrast, which comes from the white-on-white look that was asked for.
